description: A complete, deterministic chain scenario — genesis, an appended block, a foreign-reference block by a second author, and a rotation with its successor genesis — plus a fork and the blocks a conforming implementation MUST reject. Ed25519 signing is deterministic, so every signature here is reproducible from the seeds in inputs.

inputs.note: Every key comes from a seed of 32 equal bytes. These are test keys with published private material and MUST NOT be used for anything but conformance testing.

sections.name: chain
sections.description: The scenario, in the order the blocks are published. A consumer that stores them in order and validates each one MUST accept all five; the digests link them, so any encoding difference shows up as a broken prev.

cases.name: alice_genesis
cases.description: Alice's genesis block: prev is null, and the four operations define two atoms, a bond and the molecule that uses them. The molecule's references resolve inside this same block.
cases.author: alice

cases.name: alice_second
cases.description: The next block of Alice's chain: prev is the digest of alice_genesis. Its molecule carries a scalar filler with a unit, whose digest is the metre atom this block defines.
cases.author: alice

cases.name: bob_foreign_reference
cases.description: Bob's genesis block, referencing Alice's genesis block in refs. Its molecule uses a bond and an atom defined there and an atom defined by its own first operation.
cases.author: bob

cases.name: alice_rotation
cases.description: The rotation block that ends Alice's chain. Exactly one rotate_key operation, prev not null, and new_pub naming a different key.
cases.author: alice

cases.name: alice_successor_genesis
cases.description: The successor chain's genesis block. It is public and names the rotation block in refs, which is what makes the succession verifiable to a node with no keys.
cases.author: alice_successor

sections.name: forks
sections.description: Two blocks of one chain sharing a prev. Detection is normative; what a node does about it is not.

cases.name: alice_second_vs_alice_fork
cases.description: Two blocks signed by Alice carry the same prev. A node that holds both MUST detect the fork; whether it rejects, flags or keeps the first is its own policy.
cases.author: alice

sections.name: fork_block
sections.description: The forking block in full. It is a well-formed, correctly signed block: what makes it a fork is the chain it arrives into, not anything inside it.

cases.name: alice_fork
cases.description: A second block claiming alice_genesis as its predecessor. It is valid in isolation; against a store that already holds alice_second it is a fork.
cases.author: alice

sections.name: invalid
sections.description: Blocks a conforming implementation MUST reject, each naming the rule it violates. Every one of them is canonical dCBOR and — except where the case is about the signature — correctly signed, so the rejection can only come from the named rule.

cases.name: tampered_signature
cases.reason: A valid genesis block with one bit of its sig field flipped.

cases.name: unknown_version
cases.reason: The v field is 2. A field a later version introduces arrives in a block this version rejects on its version, never as an extra key.

cases.name: unknown_block_type
cases.reason: The type field is "secret". There are exactly three block types.

cases.name: empty_ops
cases.reason: The ops list is empty.

cases.name: unknown_block_key
cases.rule: spec/02-block-format.md, Validation rule 8 (deterministic encoding, including the closed-map rule)
cases.reason: The block map carries a "note" key its definition does not declare. An unknown key is a rejection, never something to ignore: a decoder that ignored it would hash bytes it did not account for.

cases.name: missing_block_key
cases.rule: spec/02-block-format.md, Validation rule 8 (deterministic encoding, including the closed-map rule)
cases.reason: The block map omits the declared ts key.

cases.name: public_block_with_enc
cases.reason: A public block carrying an enc field, which belongs to a private block.

cases.name: unknown_operation
cases.rule: spec/02-block-format.md, Validation rule 8 (deterministic encoding, including the closed-map rule)
cases.reason: An operation whose op value is "delete_atom". There are exactly four operation types.

cases.name: unknown_operation_key
cases.rule: spec/02-block-format.md, Validation rule 8 (deterministic encoding, including the closed-map rule)
cases.reason: A create_atom operation carrying an extra "lang" key. The closed-map rule governs operation maps too.

cases.name: rotate_key_in_public_block
cases.reason: A rotate_key operation in a public block. It may appear only in a rotation block, so that a chain ends where the type field says it ends.

cases.name: rotation_block_as_genesis
cases.reason: A rotation block with a null prev. A rotation block ends a chain, and there is no chain to end.

cases.name: rotation_block_two_operations
cases.reason: A rotation block carrying a second operation. It MUST contain exactly one rotate_key operation and no others.

cases.name: rotation_to_the_same_key
cases.reason: new_pub equals the block's own pub. A chain would end in favour of itself.

cases.name: duplicate_refs
cases.reason: The refs list names the same digest twice. The duplicate half of rule 10 is structural and is checked at decoding.

cases.name: cid_in_prev
cases.reason: The prev field carries a 36-byte CIDv1 instead of the raw 32-byte digest. Internal references are digests; the CID appears only at the API boundary.

cases.name: filler_type_out_of_range
cases.reason: A filler of type 5. The v1 vocabulary is types 0 to 4.

cases.name: filler_value_shape_mismatch
cases.reason: A type 0 filler carrying text. Each type tag is bound to exactly one value shape.

cases.name: empty_fillers
cases.reason: A create_molecule operation with an empty fillers list; the CDDL requires at least one.

cases.name: private_block_with_plaintext_ops
cases.reason: A private block carrying a plaintext ops field. Its operations live inside enc.

cases.name: private_block_short_enc
cases.reason: An enc field shorter than the 16-byte Poly1305 tag cannot be the output of the AEAD.

cases.name: private_block_wrong_nonce_size
cases.reason: A 12-byte nonce. XChaCha20 takes 24 bytes.

cases.name: private_block_missing_nonce
cases.rule: spec/02-block-format.md, Validation rule 8 (deterministic encoding, including the closed-map rule)
cases.reason: A private block with no nonce field.

cases.name: signed_by_another_key
cases.reason: A block claiming Alice's pub and signed by Bob's key.
